_ledgerMapping._comment: Manifest IDs were assigned when the harness was built; the review ledger (findings-claude.json / findings-claude.md) uses its own numbering. Mapping: manifest F1/F2 = acceptance criteria AC1/AC2 (they verify the PR's core fix, not defects); manifest F3 = ledger F3 (Restarting-guard suppression); manifest F4 = ledger F4 (missed-window, refuted); manifest F7 = ledger F6 (deleted Succeeded member); manifest F5/F6 = behavior contracts with no corresponding ledger defect (scale-in exclusion, Failed-during-inplace-update).
